title: [Launched] Generally Available: Files knowledge source for Foundry IQ
summary: Upload files directly to a managed knowledge source in Foundry IQ. Foundry IQ processes and indexes the files for retrieval through a knowledge base, so you don't need to provision a storage account or scheduled indexer.Learn more.
